glosses.notes: Usually means the fruit; the color is normally 橙色.

examples.sentence: 这个橙子看着不大，吃起来却很甜。
超市今天的橙子很甜，所以我又买了几个。
她把橙子放在家里，准备明天再吃。

example_translations.translation: This orange does not look very big, but it is very sweet.
The oranges at the supermarket were very sweet today, so I bought a few more.
She put the oranges at home and plans to eat them tomorrow.

glosses.notes: Usually means uncooked rice or rice as an ingredient; a bowl of cooked rice is normally 米饭.

examples.sentence: 在南方，大米是很多家庭每天都离不开的主食。
这种大米煮出来很香，所以食堂一直用它。
最近大米价格涨了不少，所以超市一打折大家就会多买一点。

example_translations.translation: In the south, rice is a staple that many families rely on every day.
This kind of rice comes out very fragrant when cooked, so the cafeteria has kept using it.
Rice prices have gone up quite a bit lately, so whenever the supermarket has a sale, people buy extra.

glosses.notes: Tofu made from soybeans, common in home cooking and everyday dishes.

examples.sentence: 今天晚饭有豆腐，我想多吃一点。
他最近不太想吃肉，晚饭常常做豆腐和青菜。
晚上妈妈做了豆腐汤，我喝了两碗。

example_translations.translation: There is tofu for dinner tonight, and I want to eat a little more of it.
He has not really wanted to eat meat lately, so dinner is often tofu and green vegetables.
Mom made tofu soup tonight, and I drank two bowls of it.

glosses.notes: Mainly used for flowers and clouds. It can also extend to small flower-shaped things, but those uses are less central for learners.

examples.sentence: 她回家的路上买了三朵花，想放在客厅的桌子上。
下午天上只有几朵云，所以大家还是决定出去走走。
花园里那朵花开得最晚，所以大家都先去看它。

example_translations.translation: On the way home, she bought three flowers and wanted to put them on the table in the living room.
There were only a few clouds in the sky that afternoon, so everyone still decided to go out for a walk.
That flower in the garden was the last to bloom, so everyone went to look at it first.

glosses.primary_gloss: measure word for pairs and sets
secondary_glosses: measure word for a look or appearance
glosses.notes: Used for certain paired or complete-set items such as glasses and gloves. It is also common in patterns like 一副样子 or 一副表情 for someone's look or expression.

examples.sentence: 他最近看电脑太久，准备周末去配一副新眼镜。
examples.meaning_en: measure word for pairs and sets

examples.sentence: 天冷以后，她给孩子买了一副手套，早上骑车就不怕冷了。
examples.meaning_en: measure word for pairs and sets

examples.sentence: 老板一进会议室就是一副很着急的样子，大家马上安静下来。
examples.meaning_en: measure word for a look or appearance

example_translations.translation: He has been looking at the computer too much lately, so he plans to get a new pair of glasses this weekend.
After the weather turned cold, she bought the child a pair of gloves, so riding in the morning was no longer so cold.
As soon as the boss walked into the meeting room with a very anxious look on his face, everyone quieted down immediately.

glosses.notes: Used to put something off to another day, often as a polite way to postpone, reschedule, or continue later.

examples.sentence: 今天太晚了，这件事我们改天再说吧。
这家店已经关门了，改天我再带你来吧。
这周我有点忙，改天再请你吃饭。

example_translations.translation: It is too late today, so let us talk about this another day.
This shop is already closed, so I will bring you back another day.
I am a bit busy this week; I will treat you to a meal another day.

glosses.primary_gloss: measure word for long, thin things
glosses.notes: Most often used as a classifier for long, thin things such as bananas, hair, ropes, or sticks. As a noun, it also means the root of a plant.

examples.sentence: 他早上没吃早饭，只带了一根香蕉就出门了。
examples.meaning_en: measure word for long, thin things

examples.sentence: 她低头的时候，发现外套上有一根头发，就顺手拿掉了。
examples.meaning_en: measure word for long, thin things

examples.sentence: 这棵树的根很深，下了几天大雨也没有倒。

example_translations.translation: He did not have breakfast that morning and left home with only a banana.
When she looked down, she noticed a strand of hair on her coat and removed it right away.
This tree's roots are deep, so it did not fall even after several days of heavy rain.

glosses.notes: Refers to China's National Day; in everyday use it often also refers to the National Day holiday period around it.

examples.sentence: 国庆快到了，街上已经很热闹了。
今年国庆假期，我们打算一起回家陪父母几天。
每年国庆期间，来这里旅游的人都特别多。

example_translations.translation: National Day is coming soon, and the streets are already getting lively.
This National Day holiday, we plan to go home together and spend a few days with our parents.
Every year during the National Day holiday, a lot of people come here as tourists.

secondary_glosses: measure word for lines of text
glosses.notes: Read háng here, not xíng. It refers to a line or row in writing, and it can also describe people standing in a line; it also works as a measure word for lines of text.

examples.sentence: 请把地址写在下一行，名字和电话已经写在上面了。
孩子们在门口站成一行，等老师带大家进去。
这首诗虽然不长，可是最后两行我一直没有读懂。
examples.meaning_en: measure word for lines of text

example_translations.translation: Please write the address on the next line; the name and phone number are already written above.
The children stood in a line at the door, waiting for the teacher to lead them in.
This poem is not long, but I still have not understood the last two lines.

glosses.notes: Usually describes something black in color; it also commonly describes the sky or surroundings becoming dark.

examples.sentence: 她今天穿了一件黑外套，看起来很精神。
外面已经黑了，我们早点回去吧。
这只猫全身都是黑的，晚上不太容易看见。

example_translations.translation: She is wearing a black coat today, and she looks very sharp.
It is already dark outside, so let us head back early.
This cat is completely black, so it is not easy to spot at night.

glosses.notes: Usually means cutting or trimming with scissors, especially hair, paper, or cloth.

examples.sentence: 天气一热，她就把头发剪短了一些。
请先把这张纸剪开，我等一下要用。
妈妈让我把这张纸剪成小块。

example_translations.translation: As soon as the weather got hot, she had her hair cut a little shorter.
Please cut this sheet of paper first; I need it in a moment.
Mom asked me to cut this sheet of paper into small pieces.

glosses.notes: Used for going to see a person, especially to show care or respect, such as a relative, teacher, elder, or someone who is ill; it is not used for visiting places.

examples.sentence: 周末我们打算去医院看望生病的老师。
放假以后，她先回老家去看望外婆。
他带了一些水果去看望生病的朋友。

example_translations.translation: We are planning to go to the hospital this weekend to visit our sick teacher.
After the break starts, she will first go back to her hometown to visit her grandmother.
He took some fruit to visit a sick friend.
